value.recommendation: Ensure the product provides functions that meet stated and implied needs under specified conditions. All required functions must be present, correct, and appropriate for the intended use.
value.typical_thresholds: Requirements coverage: 100% of must-have FRs implemented and tested. Defect escape rate to production: < 1% of released stories. Functional correctness: zero P0 functional defects in release.
value.risk_summary: Incomplete or incorrect functionality directly undermines user trust and product value. Gaps between specified and implemented behaviour cause downstream integration failures and regulatory non-compliance.

value.recommendation: Design the system to perform specified functions under stated conditions for a defined period without failure. Address maturity, availability, fault tolerance, and recoverability systematically.
value.typical_thresholds: Availability: >= 99.9% for standard systems, >= 99.99% for mission-critical. MTBF: >= 720 hours for production services. MTTR: <= 30 minutes for P1 incidents. Fault tolerance: system must degrade gracefully under partial failures.
value.risk_summary: Unreliable software erodes user confidence and causes financial loss. Failures in safety-critical domains can endanger lives. Without recoverability targets, incidents have no measurable resolution criteria.

value.recommendation: Optimise resource usage relative to the amount of resources used under stated conditions. Consider time behaviour, resource utilisation, and capacity to handle anticipated load.
value.typical_thresholds: API p95 response time: <= 200ms under normal load. p99: <= 500ms. Throughput: system must sustain peak load with < 5% degradation. CPU and memory utilisation: <= 70% at peak to maintain headroom.
value.risk_summary: Poor performance efficiency causes poor user experience, increased infrastructure costs, and capacity failures under load. Unmonitored resource utilisation leads to unexpected service degradation or outages.

value.recommendation: Ensure the product can be used by specified users to achieve goals with effectiveness, efficiency, and satisfaction in a specified context of use. Address learnability, operability, and user error protection.
value.typical_thresholds: Task completion rate: >= 90% for primary user flows. User error rate: <= 5% on critical tasks. User satisfaction (SUS): >= 68 (industry average). WCAG 2.1 AA compliance: 100% for public-facing interfaces.
value.risk_summary: Poor usability increases support costs, causes user errors that may have downstream consequences, and reduces adoption. In regulated domains, accessibility failures result in legal liability.

value.recommendation: Protect information and data so that persons or systems have authorised access appropriate to their types and levels. Address confidentiality, integrity, non-repudiation, accountability, and authenticity.
value.typical_thresholds: 100% of API endpoints must enforce authentication. Zero critical or high CVEs unpatched beyond 72 hours. 100% of sensitive data encrypted at rest and in transit. Audit log coverage: 100% of privileged actions.
value.risk_summary: Security breaches result in data loss, regulatory fines, reputational damage, and in critical infrastructure, physical harm. Without non-repudiation and accountability controls, forensic investigation after incidents is impossible.

value.recommendation: Ensure the product can exchange information with other products, systems, or components, and perform its required functions while sharing an environment and resources. Address co-existence and interoperability.
value.typical_thresholds: Integration test pass rate: 100% before release. Zero breaking API changes without a versioning policy. API contract violations in production: zero. Backward compatibility maintained for >= 2 major versions.
value.risk_summary: Incompatible systems create integration failures that break consumer applications. Breaking changes without versioning force emergency updates across dependent services and can cause production outages.

value.recommendation: Ensure the product can be effectively and efficiently modified by designated maintainers. Address modularity, reusability, analysability, modifiability, and testability.
value.typical_thresholds: Unit test coverage: >= 80% for production code paths. Cyclomatic complexity: <= 10 per function. Code duplication: <= 5%. Technical debt ratio (SonarQube): <= 5%. Mean time to implement a small change: <= 1 working day.
value.risk_summary: Poorly maintainable code increases change lead time, magnifies the cost of every bug fix and feature, and creates knowledge silos. High complexity increases defect rates and makes refactoring risky.

value.recommendation: Ensure the product can be transferred from one hardware, software, or environmental context to another with defined effectiveness and efficiency. Address adaptability, installability, and replaceability.
value.typical_thresholds: Deployment success rate across target environments: >= 99%. Zero environment-specific defects in staging that do not reproduce in production. Containerisation: 100% of services deployable from a single image. Config via environment variables: no hard-coded environment specifics.
value.risk_summary: Poor portability creates environment-specific bugs that are expensive to diagnose and fix. Lock-in to a single vendor or runtime reduces negotiating power and increases migration cost significantly.
